q: The Koopman operator Uf of an MPT f is defined by Uf(φ) = φ∘f. It is:
opts: A bounded self-adjoint operator on L²(μ)
A bounded unitary operator on L²(μ)
exp: The Koopman operator is unitary (isometric and surjective) because f preserves μ: ‖Uf φ‖² = ∫|φ∘f|² dμ = ∫|φ|² dμ = ‖φ‖². Ergodic theory can be translated into spectral theory of unitary operators via Koopman.
